evals.prompt: I want to disable telemetry and bloatware on my fresh Windows 11 Pro install. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: Reads references/debloating.md and references/gpo.md. Creates restore point first. Shows telemetry disable commands and bloatware removal with preview step. Provides rollback commands. Does NOT disable Windows Update or Defender.

evals.prompt: Help me harden my Windows 11 workstation to CIS benchmark standards.
evals.expected_output: Reads references/security.md. Creates restore point. Applies CIS settings (account policies, audit policy, SMB, UAC, BitLocker). Provides rollback commands for each section. Does NOT disable critical services.

evals.prompt: My Windows 11 PC is slow. How do I optimize performance?
evals.expected_output: Reads references/performance.md. Shows visual effects reduction, power plan changes, memory/disk diagnostics, and startup optimization. Does NOT recommend disabling critical services or Windows Update.
